_comment_about_this_file: Annotated hardened vercel.json — copy what applies and merge into your project. Vercel reads vercel.json at deploy time; restart by running 'vercel --prod' to take effect.

headers._comment: Apply security headers to every path. Override per-path below if needed.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://va.vercel-scripts.com https://vercel.live; connect-src 'self' https://vitals.vercel-insights.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

redirects._comment: Apex → www (or reverse) — pick one canonical form. Vercel issues TLS for both regardless.

functions._comment: Per-function memory/timeout/region overrides. Region 'iad1' = us-east-1 by default; use 'all' for global edge.

images._comment: next/image allow-list. Restrict to known origins; never use ['**'] in prod.

crons._comment: Vercel Cron requires Pro+. Authenticate cron handlers via the x-vercel-signature header check inside the function.
